content.caseIdentity: Anvar P.V. v. P.K. Basheer, (2014) 10 SCC 473
content.facts: The Court examined the statutory method for proving electronic records.
questionsBeforeCourt: Whether electronic records can be admitted without the applicable certificate route.
content.ratioDecidendi: Electronic records must satisfy the special statutory proof requirements applicable to computer outputs.
content.holding: The Court reaffirmed the certificate discipline for electronic evidence.
content.relevance: Use with BSA s. 63 and digital-record admissibility.
